functions.name: update-campaign-linkedin-accounts
functions.description: Replace the entire set of LinkedIn sender accounts assigned to a campaign.

In a paused campaign, removing a sender stops its assigned leads and those leads cannot be resumed. A scheduled campaign becomes DRAFT.

functions.name: update-campaign-schedule
functions.description: Fully replace a campaign's local daily operating window, active weekdays, timezone, and optional calendar-date boundaries.

endDate.description: Calendar date to stop automatically; omitted or null clears the end boundary. Must be after startDate when both are set.

campaignId.description: Campaign whose entire operating schedule will be replaced.

timeZoneId.description: IANA timezone, for example America/New_York; retains local scheduling meaning.

items.description: An active local weekday.

enabledDays.description: Complete set of active weekdays; days not listed become disabled.

dailyStartTime.description: Local daily start time HH:mm:ss, strictly before the end time.

FunctionInput_heyreach_updatecampaignsch.description: Complete replacement of a campaign schedule using local times, calendar dates, and an IANA timezone.

campaignId.description: Campaign whose replacement schedule was accepted.

acknowledged.description: Provider acknowledged the schedule write; does not activate the campaign.

FunctionOutput_heyreach_updatecampaignsc.description: Acknowledgment that the provider accepted the replacement campaign schedule.

tags.instructions: Get campaignId from `list-campaigns`. Supply a complete schedule, not a partial patch. Only DRAFT, SCHEDULED, and PAUSED campaigns can be changed; use `disable-campaign` before changing an active one. A scheduled campaign becomes DRAFT. A campaign's startDate cannot change after its first start. Times are local to the named timezone, not UTC instants.

functions.name: update-campaign-sequence
functions.description: Create or fully replace a draft, scheduled, or paused campaign's workflow, preserving explicit branch, message, delay, and integration choices.

payload.description: Node-specific configuration, required for configurable actions; omitted for action-only nodes.

postUrl.description: LinkedIn post targeted by LIKE_POST; provisional provider mapping.

messages.description: Ordinary message variants; preserve placeholders and Unicode.

items.description: An ordinary message variant, preserved without changing placeholders or Unicode.

resourceType.description: Instantly destination type, explicitly required for that node.

bisonCampaignId.description: Optional EmailBison campaign ID; omission creates a lead without campaign assignment.

fallbackMessage.description: Fallback message; an empty string is explicit, not omission.

stopExternalLead.description: Stop in EmailBison campaign on reply; defaults true with a campaign, null accepted only without a campaign and normalized to omission.

pauseExternalLead.description: Pause Smartlead lead on reply; defaults true.

removeExternalLead.description: Remove from Instantly campaign on reply; forbidden for LIST, defaults true for CAMPAIGN.

instantlyResourceId.description: Instantly destination list or campaign GUID.

toBeWithdrawnAfterDays.description: Connection-request withdrawal delay in days; supported range requires validation.

nodeType.description: Workflow action or branching condition; END terminates the path.

actionDelay.description: Delay before this action in actionDelayUnit units. Omitted delays are computed: root zero, other nodes three hours.

actionDelayUnit.description: Delay unit; must accompany actionDelay when explicitly set.

conditionalNode.description: Required true branch for CONNECTION_REQUEST, CHECK_IS_CONNECTION, CHECK_IS_OPEN_PROFILE, and FIND_EMAIL; forbidden otherwise.

externalReference.description: Optional caller tracking ID; omission removes it in the replacement tree.

unconditionalNode.description: Required next/false branch for non-END nodes; forbidden for END.

sequence.description: Complete workflow rooted at its first action; omitted branches and fields are not preserved.

campaignId.description: Campaign whose complete workflow is being replaced.

FunctionInput_heyreach_updatecampaignseq.description: Campaign identifier and the complete replacement workflow tree.

campaignId.description: Campaign whose workflow replacement was acknowledged.

acknowledged.description: Provider accepted the workflow replacement; not a promise that any action has executed.

FunctionOutput_heyreach_updatecampaignse.description: Acknowledgment of the complete workflow replacement.

tags.instructions: Read the current workflow with `get-campaign-sequence` before editing. Supply the complete tree, not a partial diff; all paths must end at END and START must not be included. Allowed campaign states are DRAFT, SCHEDULED, and PAUSED. Pause an active campaign with `disable-campaign` first. Updating a scheduled campaign reverts it to DRAFT; use `enable-campaign` when ready.
